text:
olivia: alert from customers in ap-southeast1: batch jobs stuck 'waiting for scratch' and a handful of timed-out GPU attaches. dashboard shows local NVMe latencies spiking. anyone oncall? :frowning:
deploy-bot: ALERT: ap-southeast1 scratch_iops_util > 93% for 7m; attach_fail_rate 13%. affected services: gpu-provisioner, batch-scheduler.
tomas: digging in. sample host shows `nvme0n1` util ~99% and high write amplification. interestingly, network snapshots show heavy metadata RPCs to the metadata service at the same time. could be overlayfs flushes plus metadata storm causing read/write amplification on local NVMe.
mei: we shipped an overlayfs metadata optimization yesterday that forces more frequent fsyncs to reduce tail latencies. looks like it increased small-sync frequency. combined with a janitor compaction sweep that started at the same minute -> perfect storm.
randall: quick mitigations: 1) temporarily revert overlayfs metadata flush (controls via feature-flag), 2) throttle janitor concurrency, 3) add attach admission rule preferring nodes with `iops_budget>=300`.
olivia: post exact commands and I'll audit the controlplane changes. customers are hitting queued job SLAs.
tomas: running canary now:
```
# revert overlayfs metadata flush
kubectl -n infra patch configmap fs-toggles --patch '{"data":{"overlayfs.metadataFlush":"false"}}'
# throttle janitor
kubectl -n infra patch configmap janitor-config --patch '{"data":{"concurrency":"1"}}'
# provisioner gate
curl -X POST https://provisioner.internal/_admin/policies -d '{"expr":"iops_budget>=300"}'
```
deploy-bot: CHANGE: overlayfs metadataFlush=false applied by tomas at 4512340027. rollback window 4512340387 if attach_error_rate increases.
mei: canary AZ attach queue dropped 160 -> 26 in ~50s, nvme util down to ~60-70%. looks promising.
randall: follow-ups: schedule a rollback-safe re-enable with high jitter for janitor work, add metric `overlayfs_sync_count` to graphs, and run a combined scale+cleanup simulation in staging to validate the new fs tweak.
olivia: also add an alert for `metadata_rpc_rate` > baseline during scale events; we should block fsync-heavy changes landing right before autoscale windows. owner infra/storage.
tomas: will roll to remaining AZs with 30s spacing. monitoring for 15m then gradual re-enable with conservative settings.
mei: filing postmortem and RFC: tie provisioner placement to both `free_scratch_slots` and `iops_budget` so future attaches consider real IOPS headroom, not just slot counts.
olivia: thanks everyone. keep this thread updated and paste postmortem checklist here when ready. :thumbsup:
